svg.aria-label: Indexers defined once, shared everywhere: 1. Database: The prowlarr-db Kustomization creates role and database prowlarr on the shared postgres-18 Cluster. The app's settings and indexers live there. 2. Secret: ExternalSecret prowlarr-secret carries the database settings and the API key from the 1Password items prowlarr and cloudnative-pg. 3. Index: Prowlarr queries the Usenet indexers you configured and hands results to the *arr apps. Torrent indexers are not configured, by decision. 4. Keep: The 5Gi prowlarr-config claim is backed up by kopiur to Ceph and R2. Backups run as UID 3002 and GID 3000.
